title: REfreshCore
description: Renewed textures with a fresh touch
body:
### RefresCore 
is a resource pack designed to refresh Minecraft's visual experience while staying true to its iconic vanilla style. RefresCore focuses on modernizing outdated textures, improving visual consistency, and adding more vibrant colors and refined details across the game
![Galery](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66885ed7c87dcaa12ef29321bdad9f274ad063a9.png)

_______________________________________________________________________________________________

## Need Help

I've noticed that the resource pack appears as "Incompatible" or "Broken" in Minecraft, even though it works correctly in the game. If you know what might be causing this issue or how to fix it, please contact me.

I also need help adding compatibility with the Eating Animation mod. If you know how to properly integrate this mod into a resource pack, I would greatly appreciate any advice or examples.

Any comments or help are welcome. Thank you!
